provenance.interpretation: All 96 frozen finalists are retained without confirmation-driven reselection. Results, behavior labels, method origins and anchors are historical observations on paired schedules. Context aliases and repeated method winners are not independent samples. Zero-clear recipes remain unsuccessful; no optimum, universal synergy or current-content success claim.
